newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK/Shanghai Hotels 1996 net up 40 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK/Shanghai Hotels 1996 net up 40 pct.

text.p: Company name Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels Ltd
NOTE - Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels owns and manages hotels. It also engages in airline catering, food retailing, club and restaurant management, property development and investment.
Net is after extraoardinary item of HK$55 million on disposal of the group's 25 percent shareholding in Cathay Pacific Catering Service (H.K.) Ltd vs nil.
Total dividend for year is 38 H.K. cents (including interim dividend of 15 cents) vs 30 cents.
The earnings per share calculation was based on profit of HK$861 million, which includes an exceptional loss of HK$95 million but excludes an extraordinary gain of HK$55 million.
The exceptional loss of HK$95 million was related to general provision against the carrying value of investments in Thailand.
